name: Ember & Sands
source:
A romance visual novel that takes place in Valanche, a fantasy tropical island based off of Bali. 

The game follows dual protagonists Kestrel Se'val and Kaspian Lestari as they run their co-owned bed and breakfast.

When rumours spread that Valanche's protective barrier is weakening, and Kaspian begins showing signs of a mysterious illness he won't talk about, Kestrel and Kaspian must confront the truths they have been avoiding—about the island, the Fire Saint and the elusive travelling fairy doctor... and about each other.

[Edited from [url=https://dreamy-cat-studio.itch.io/ember-sands-demo]itch.io[/url]]
